messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER — P1: runtime crashloop (segfault) observed in cluster prod-west-1. Affected service: redwood-runtime-v2.3.3. ~150 requests failing across 6 pods. Pager: eva-pager

 eva-pager: alerted on SIGSEGV from container runtime on host host-prod-45. auto-retries causing crashloop. starting triage.

 matt-sre: I'm on it, pulling logs from host-prod-45.

 alice.dev: FYI I've seen similar after the fused-kernel change. Could be the custom fused attention path in vLLM / TRT.

 sanjay-ml: stack traces show GPU SIGSEGV in fused_attention.cu. snippet:
```text
[2026-03-15T20:01:12Z] runtime: signal 11 (SIGSEGV), address 0x7f9c12ab
#0 0x7f9b6f in fused_attention_forward(cuStream_t, ...)
#1 0x55aa1b in serve_token
#2 0x55a800 in main
```

 ben-runtime: Also seeing `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` in the runtime logs and repeated `invalid kernel parameter` messages from the TRT integration.

 matt-sre: immediate mitigation plan: cordon + drain host-prod-45 to stop noisy crashloops, scale down the deployment to reduce blast radius.

 alice.dev: can we set REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 on the deployment and restart pods? That will force fallback to safe kernels and avoid the fused path.

 ben-runtime: confirmed env toggle exists. I'll spin a hotpatch canary with the env override and 1% traffic.

 deploy-bot: deploy request created by ben-runtime: apply env REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 to deployment runtime-prod. Status: pending approval.

 eva-pager: customers affected: 4 Dedicated tenants (acct-178, acct-442, acct-562, acct-770) seeing increased 5xx. CS notified and opening escalation channel.

 matt-sre: cordon/drain executed, shifting pods off host-prod-45. scaled replicas to avoid scheduling on the faulty host. starting canary with env override now.

 ben-runtime: canary up, initial logs show no segfaults after env toggle. request failure rate on canary traffic down to ~3%.

 sanjay-ml: adding temporary alert rule: if segfault rate > 1% across cluster trigger paging and auto-throttle fused kernel usage.

 alice.dev: rollback / mitigation commands if needed:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/runtime -n prod REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1
kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime -n prod
```

 oncall-handoff: quick handoff — I'm taking over for next 30m. Current status: canary stable, cordoned node drained, 4 tenants impacted, CS escalation open. Contact matt-sre or ben-runtime for runtime changes.

 matt-sre: noted handoff. Next steps: promote canary to 100% if stable for 10m, then publish patch to disable fused kernel by default until root cause is fixed. Create incident postmortem.

 eva-pager: CS update posted to affected tenants. Offered temporary routing to other region for high-SLA customers.

 ben-runtime: creating patch branch to add bounds-checking in fused_attention; that will take a few days. Plan: short-term env toggle + image pin, long-term kernel fix + unit/regression tests.

 deploy-bot: rollout completed: REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 applied to runtime-prod. New pods in stable state, health checks passing.

 matt-sre: impact metrics: 503/5xx count dropped ~87%, error budget preserved. Downgrading pager unless regressions. Incident remains open for postmortem and root cause.

 incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Pager resolved to oncall-handoff. Incident severity downgraded to SEV-2. Postmortem required.

 oncall-handoff: I'll own the postmortem. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. Please drop logs, traces, and artifacts into the incident doc.

 alice.dev: copying logs/artifacts to /incidents/2109876543 for postmortem. Will follow up with repro steps and a minimal test case.

 eva-pager: closing loop with CS and customers, will confirm SLA credits if any. :white_check_mark:

 matt-sre: thanks everyone. I'll monitor for 30m then uncordon host-prod-45 if it stays healthy.
